ref: ADR-0005: an integer power is exact only up to the exponent 1000, so that one box cannot build an unbounded number; above it power is computed in xs:double
note: 3^1001 has an exponent above 1000, so it is a double power, Infinity here: power raises err:FORG0001 at its box V1. Exactly, it would be a number of 478 digits.
